BMI

Calculate body mass index from height and weight.

Result

Enter values to calculate

Formula

BMI = weight (kg) / height² (m²)

Clinical interpretation

  • Underweight: <18.5
  • Normal: 18.5–24.9
  • Overweight: 25–29.9
  • Obesity: ≥30

BMI is a screening tool and does not capture body composition.
